This is assignment scaffolding. Pull requests opened here are closed
automatically and are **not** part of any submission — we will not see it as
your work.

**Submit by email**, as the assignment says:

Work in **your own fork**, not here.

Found a genuine problem with the scaffolding — a broken fixture, a typo in the
